lines.287767431322091520:
I tried to say something today. Told Sheriff Wulfe I didn’t feel right working the night desk alone with Roberts. He just laughed it off, like I was imagining things. Said Roberts was “solid” and I should be glad to have an experienced deputy on call. 

I couldn't explain it. Nothing I could write in a report. He doesn’t do anything wrong… But, sometimes I swear he’s listening for things that aren’t there. I keep catching him smiling at nothing or just... the way he's got that wet smell stuck to him.
lines.287767433054339072:
I wish they’d put American Lee on the graveyard shift instead. At least with him I could relax, laugh, breathe. Around Roberts the whole place just gets... cold...

Maybe it’s just me. Maybe I’m losing it. I didn't use to feel like this...
lines.288803635870642176:
The first day of volunteers searching for missing local Alice Baker turned up nothing. Weather worked against the volunteers, with persistent rain and strong winds throughout the day. 
“Right now, no news is good news,” said one of the participants. “We’ll keep looking for as long as we have to.”
lines.289834323511689216:
Anchor Keystone Safe: Operating the Combination Lock

1. Move Dial Clockwise (<sprite name="Rotate_Clockwise">)to the first number of the code sequence.
2. Then Counter Clockwise (<sprite name="Rotate_CounterClockwise">) and stop on the second number.
3. Clockwise (<sprite name="Rotate_Clockwise">) again, stop on the third number.
4. Then Counter Clockwise (<sprite name="Rotate_CounterClockwise">) and move to the fourth. Mechanism will yield.
 
Note: If a number is overshot, restart the process.
lines.292057803418320896: Newspaper: Musician Linked to Missing Person
lines.292057842307907584: Silver Pines Sheriff's Department remains secretive about suspicions of foul play regarding the woman who went missing in the area last week.
lines.292057844186955776: “Until we’ve established Miss Baker’s whereabouts we can’t say anything for sure”, Sheriff Wulfe comments, but confirms that they have detained a person regarding the disappearance. Sources close to the sheriff's department have identified the suspect as a musician from out of town.
lines.312321993303212032:
In the desert
I saw a creature, naked, bestial,
Who, squatting upon the ground,
Held his heart in his hands,
And ate of it.
I said, 'Is it good, friend?'
'It is bitter - bitter,' he answered;

'But I like it
Because it is bitter,
And because it is my heart.'
lines.312698191975890944:
Eddie Velvet, age 25-35
Occupation: Musician (?)
Criminal record: unknown
Place of residence: unknown
lines.312698193729110016:
Note: 
-Supposedly has a gun, no firearms registered under his name. Proceed with caution.
-A drifter hitched a ride with Eddie out of Oregon, said Eddie was heading up North.
-A Mr Holloway at the "Crimson Bear Motel" in Silver Pines confirmed they have a guest under "Velvet" staying there.
lines.314541509051498496:
Eddie Velvet.
I told you I'm never leaving Silver Pines, but you're persistent... A part of me really wants you to be. You keep coming to see me after your shows. I keep letting you in. Why am I doing this...


We'll never leave together.
lines.314541555696353280: Eddie. Eddie. Eddie. Eddie. Why are you always on my mind? Eddie Velvet am I falling in love with you? You wanted me to come see you at the Bear again. I hate going there. Holloway makes me feel cheap, makes me feel like a whore.
lines.314541651313901568: I saw the Deacon on Church Hill again, Eddie. He takes me to such peaceful places. We speak a lot about the past. About what happened on the mountain. I pretend like it's helping. It makes him smile. I like seeing him smile. I never talk about you though. I never talk about the little man. Or how I change when I'm around you. How everyone changes around you...
lines.314541746952421376:
You want us to leave. The little man won't let me leave. I have a feeling you know... Tonight I'll take you to the special place. Maybe it will help you see. Maybe you don't care.


Something bad is about to happen... I can't stop it.
lines.320342440477278208: The Sheriff will be stopping by sometimes tomorrow. Says she's busy with the evacuation and getting everyone out of town. I told her someone smashed up the entire gallery and that Laker is gone... She had the same idea as us. That nut probably did it himself... I think the best move is to just not make too big a deal out of any of this, nothing good will come of it.
lines.359096204050644992:
EXT. GAS STATION – NIGHT

A car sits parked, engine running.

The DRIVER enters the gas station. Inside, the CLERK is busy unpacking boxes of cigarettes with a box cutter.

DRIVER
What are you doing here?

CLERK
Sure with the smokes and matches, that’ll ring up to 49 dollars, sir.
lines.359099631015116800:
DRIVER
You’re dying. It’s already over.

CLERK
No, no—that wasn’t me.
Now listen, I had nothing to do with that.
I’m telling you, you got the wrong—

The Driver grabs the back of the Clerk’s head with one hand and the box cutter with the other. Blood sprays over the counter as he drives the blade into the Clerk’s eye socket.

DRIVER
Why keep struggling?
lines.359099848670134272:
The Driver exits, lighting a cigarette.

CLOSE UP — A “NO SMOKING” SIGN.

CLOSE UP — The cigarette is flicked out the window.

The gas station explodes.

FADE TO:

The Driver speeds off into the night.

END SCENE
lines.359440976518922240:
To anyone returning:

We just got word from townhall that the search is to be called off for now. Winds are picking up and the Gondola won't be safe to use if gets any worse. There's still a slim chance that the girl's alive somewhere up here so we're leaving behind some supplies in the back for when we can resume the search.
lines.360532263598899200: I tried telling Eddie again. He gave her a gun for protection. He'll never understand. The gun feels so nice.
lines.363114172262727680:
A Ride to the stars.


Join us for a summer of star gazing on the slopes of Mt.Siah Kopa.
Gondola services will operate during extended hours throughout the month of August.
Take someone special along for the kind of moment that lasts forever.
